summary: FieldForce integration testing complete. All backend APIs and frontend pages functioning correctly. Landing page has all required sections (Hero, Features, Case Studies, Industries, API docs, Testimonials). Login/Register flows work with demo credentials. Dashboard shows stats and quick actions.
passed_tests: Backend API Tests (13/13 passed):
- Health endpoint returns healthy status with database connected
- Login with demo credentials (demo@fieldforce.io / Test123!) works
- Login correctly rejects invalid/nonexistent credentials
- User registration creates account and returns JWT token
- /auth/me returns current user profile with valid token
- /auth/me requires authentication (401 without token)
- Dashboard stats endpoint returns projects/forms/submissions/enumerators counts
- Dashboard recent activity endpoint returns submissions list
- Projects endpoint returns user's organization projects
- Forms endpoint returns user's organization forms
- Submissions endpoint returns user's organization submissions
Frontend UI Tests (All passed):
- FieldForce landing page loads at /solutions/fieldforce
- Landing page has Hero section with phone mockup
- Landing page has Features section (6 features)
- Landing page has Case Studies section (3 case studies)
- Landing page has Industries section (8 industries)
- Landing page has API documentation section
- Landing page has Testimonials section
- Landing page has CTA section
- Login page at /solutions/fieldforce/app/login works
- Login page shows demo credentials hint
- Login redirects to dashboard after successful auth
- Dashboard shows 4 stat cards (Projects, Forms, Submissions, Team Members)
- Dashboard shows Quick Actions (Create Form, View Data, GPS Map, Manage Team)
- Dashboard shows Getting Started guide when no projects exist
- Register page at /solutions/fieldforce/app/register has all form fields
- Navigation between dashboard pages works (Projects, Forms, etc.)
- Logout redirects to landing page
- 'Back to Solutions' link present in minimal header
seed_data_creation: Demo user auto-created by backend on startup via create_fieldforce_demo_user()
context_for_next_testing_agent: FieldForce integration complete following Survey360 pattern. Routes: /solutions/fieldforce (landing), /solutions/fieldforce/app/login, /solutions/fieldforce/app/register, /solutions/fieldforce/app/dashboard. Auth uses JWT stored in localStorage as 'fieldforce_token'. Demo user auto-created on backend startup. Backend APIs at /api/fieldforce/*. SSO exchange endpoint at /api/fieldforce/auth/sso-exchange for DataVision admin integration.
